## File: facebookresearch_pytouch/sensors/pytouch_sensors/digit/digit.py

Prompts

```
['find all connected DIGIT force sensor devices using pyudev video4linux subsystem', 'create a Digit object with a given serial number to control a DIGIT force sensor', 'connect to a DIGIT device and configure stream resolution and FPS settings', 'set the RGB LED intensity on a DIGIT device between 0 and 15 per channel', 'grab a single image frame from the DIGIT force sensor and optionally transpose it']
```

```
{'find_digit_devices': 'find all connected DIGIT force sensor devices using pyudev video4linux subsystem', 'create_digit_instance': 'create a Digit object with a given serial number to control a DIGIT force sensor', 'connect_digit_stream': 'connect to a DIGIT device and configure stream resolution and FPS settings', 'set_digit_led_intensity': 'set the RGB LED intensity on a DIGIT device between 0 and 15 per channel', 'get_digit_frame': 'grab a single image frame from the DIGIT force sensor and optionally transpose it'}
```
